SDL3-CS managed-only patch release that restores source-generator compatibility with supported .NET SDK compiler hosts.

## Package Versions

| Package family | Version |
|----------------|---------|
| `SDL3-CS` | `3.4.16.1` |
| Native platform package families | unchanged from `3.4.16.0` |

## Changes

- Restored the source generator's Roslyn 4.4 compatibility baseline and added a package-level regression check, preventing CS9057 with SDK compiler hosts that use Roslyn 5.0 ([#296](https://github.com/edwardgushchin/SDL3-CS/issues/296)).

Applications should update `SDL3-CS` to `3.4.16.1`; existing native platform package versions are reused unchanged.
